entries.name: context7
entries.summary: Current documentation for libraries and frameworks, looked up by name and version.
entries.why: Workers read the docs of the library version the project uses instead of what the model remembers.

entries.name: playwright
entries.summary: Drives a real browser: open pages, click, fill forms, read the page and take screenshots.
entries.why: A worker can try the web UI it just built, step by step, beyond the headless self-check.

entries.name: exa
entries.summary: Web search built for AI: returns the content of the pages it finds.
entries.why: Research and document goals get fresh, citable sources beyond the built-in web search.

entries.name: brave-search
entries.summary: Brave's independent web index: web, news and image search.
entries.why: Research and document goals get fresh sources beyond the built-in web search.
